name: Air Fryer Pork Milanese with Kale and Apple Salad

components.name: Pork Milanese

ingredients.name: Raw boneless pork loin cutlets, pounded thin

steps: Season and marinate pounded pork cutlets with mustard, garlic powder and salt for at least one hour.
Prepare shallow egg and breadcrumb trays. Dip pork into egg and then firmly into breadcrumbs; lightly mist with measured oil.
Air fry at 200 C in batches approximately 10-14 minutes, turning halfway, until 63 C internal and a three-minute rest for whole cuts.
Portion warm pork with potato side; assemble kale-and-apple salad cold at serving. Freeze only the pork and potatoes if necessary.

components.name: Air-Fried Potatoes
steps: Cook cubed potatoes in the air fryer separately, shaking several times, until browned and tender.

components.name: Kale & Apple Salad
steps: Mix cider vinegar, olive oil and maple syrup as dressing. Massage kale briefly and keep chopped apples in a separate container until eating.
